title: EquityBrief fixture manifest
description: Every captured input in one fixture: the endpoint, the query and the UTC instant of the fetch. The suite asserts its own required fields against this file, so the shape is declared once.

capturedFor.description: the session date the fixture is built around

noCredentials.description: the manifest's own assertion that no credential appears in any captured response. The check scans as well, because an assertion nobody tests is a comment.

file.description: the captured response, relative to the fixture folder and never absolute

query.description: the query as sent, with no credential in it

fetchedAt.description: the UTC instant of the fetch, so what was known at the time is legible later
